hypothesis.title: [Illustrative] TREM2 agonism helps only once plaques are established
hypothesis.statement: TREM2 agonism has no effect on neuritic dystrophy at an early stage and reduces it at a late stage, in brains with functional TREM2.

claims: not (treatment == 'agonist' and trem2_function == 'normal' and stage == 'early') or dystrophy_change == 'none'
not (treatment == 'agonist' and trem2_function == 'normal' and stage == 'late') or dystrophy_change == 'decrease'
